title: The Broken Compass
scene: At 5:50 PM, the ship's brass compass was smashed. The bridge was sealed during a squall from 5:30 to 6:10.

suspects.name: Lars Voss
suspects.testimony: I was on the bridge at 5:50, steering through the squall.
suspects.contradiction: The helm log shows autopilot engaged from 5:32, and brass dust was in Lars's glove.

suspects.name: Amara Nath
suspects.testimony: I was below in the chart room from 5:40 to 6:00.
suspects.alibiProof: The chart room lamp meter shows Amara's bunk occupied at 5:49.

suspects.name: Colin Reed
suspects.testimony: I was lashing crates on the foredeck at 5:50.
suspects.alibiProof: The deck camera shows Colin knotting rope at 5:48 and 5:52.

suspects.name: Sofia Lund
suspects.testimony: I was plating dinner in the galley at 5:50.
suspects.alibiProof: The galley timer was punched by Sofia at 5:47 and 5:54.
